sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Unique-values dropdown: the alias-table "Locale" column gets a new "Locale info" section — "- Language" (one entry per distinct locale language, e.g. "English", "Chinese (China)", via new `_findCellLocaleInfo()`) and "- Primary" (fixed "🥇 primary"/"◦ not primary" flags, from MusicBrainz's own `(primary)` marker). New `_highlightLocaleLanguageMatch()` highlights the matched language text. Alias Types with no Locale at all (e.g. "Legal name", "Search hint") contribute to neither facet.
